about: The rights items of the public release checklist (docs/release.md, T9.4.1). A person sets 'status' to 'cleared' and writes the evidence; `pnpm release-check --public` fails while any item is not cleared. Last reviewed by the model on 2026-11-06 from docs/rights.md; none of this is legal advice.

items.what: The recording (Marta Czech) may be hosted on a public URL
items.evidence: ripped from a YouTube video; the performer's or label's permission is not obtained. The owner's decision is a private, non-profit preview and a link to the performer's video (docs/rights.md, open item 1)

items.what: The score engraving and the data drawn from it (CP 0101, Contrapunctus Press)
items.evidence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, read from page 3 of the PDF itself; credited on the credits page and under the score; derived data carries the same licence (non-commercial use only)

items.what: The IMSLP file page still shows the same licence for CP 0101
items.evidence: re-check on IMSLP's page for the file before any public release (docs/rights.md, open item 2); not checked from this machine
CC0 1.0, read from the file's identification block (docs/rights.md)

items.what: The piano samples of the sampler mode (Salamander Grand Piano V3)
items.evidence: CC BY 3.0, credited on the credits page (docs/sampler.md; one source claims public domain, not confirmed)

items.what: The sampler mode plays the recording's aligned timings (her phrasing)
items.evidence: the owner's question for a public release: docs/rights.md item 4, docs/sampler.md; an even-tempo piano from the score would avoid it and is not built
